notes: Ludum Dare 55 jam (https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/55/a-short-summoning; https://m039.itch.io/a-short-summoning) by Dmitry Mozgin / m039. Complete Unity 2022.3.12f1 project with playable MainMenu, Level1-Level4, and EndGame scenes in EditorBuildSettings (control a wizard, activate altars, summon ghosts). MIT at the repo-root LICENSE (Copyright 2024 Dmitry Mozgin). Official Unity packages only (URP 14.0.9, Cinemachine 2.9.7, ProBuilder 5.2.2, TextMesh Pro 3.0.6, Timeline, uGUI, Visual Scripting, Recorder, and built-in modules). Bundled fonts: Handlee (OFL 1.1), Permanent Marker (Apache-2.0), Raleway (OFL 1.1), and Liberation Sans (OFL 1.1). Music CrEEP.mp3 is TokyoGeisha's CC0 loop from OpenGameArt (exact 3574665-byte match). TextMesh Pro EmojiOne sprites/asset and TMP Documentation were omitted; TMP Settings m_defaultSpriteAsset was cleared because it pointed at the omitted EmojiOne asset. No DOTween, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no Asset Store packages, no LFS, no DLL.
